title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast 2000 Go Cola Prefilled Pod & Refill
description: Cola from the Dojo Blast 2000 Go range delivers a sweet, nostalgic vape inspired by the familiar taste of fizzy Cola. With its syrupy sweetness, caramel tang and subtle sparkle, it's a playful flavour that offers both sweetness and bubbly refresment with every puff. Each pack includes a 2ml transparent pod prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and a 2ml refill container for extended vaping. Powered by Vaporesso's COREX 2.0 Mesh Coil, it ensures consistent flavour and vapour with every draw. The transparent pod design allows for quick visual checks of your e-liquid level and fits easily into the Dojo Blast 2000 Go device for clean, hassle-free use. How to Use: 1. Remove all packaging 2. Remove the red silicone covers from the base and top of the refill pod 3. Attach the 2ml pod to the 2ml refill 4. Insert the combined pod into the Dojo Blast device, twisting to secure 5. Inhale to vape—no buttons or setup required. 6. When finished, replace with a fresh pod+refill pack.
